Name: Sprites for ohodavi's anime portraits
Author: EgregiousCat
Description:
This mod makes Maru, Sebastian and Leah have a sprite more fitting to ohodavi's anime portrait. They also include outside winter versions to be used with a seasonal villagers mod.

[b]This was initially for my personal use only so I apologize if this isn't the most user friendly way to upload a mod.[/b] Sebastian's sprite sheet is made for [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7303]Sebastian Smokes Weed[/url]﻿. I don't think I'll edit it to fit his standard smoking I apologize for that.

Based on Poltergeister's amazing [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url].

[b]FUTURE UPDATES ?
[/b]I tweak a lot of sprites to my liking, but most have only minor changes I don't think are worth an upload.
I am planning to maybe add Evelyn, though I am not satisfied with the one I made right now.

[b]TO INSTALL: [/b]
Replace the files in either [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿ or [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url] folder in the appropriate characters' folder. The naming by default is made for the Seasonal version, edit it accordingly if using the non-Seasonal version.
